The global maritime trade will not grow in 2026 because of disruptions on key shipping routes, including in the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea, says a 2026 report on maritime transport by the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD). According to UNCTAD estimates, in 2025, maritime trade increased by 1.9% to 12.3 billion tons. Growth is expected to recover to 3.2% in 2027.

AFU major lured to 'date' and shot dead in Kharkov An officer was killed in the evening near an apartment building in Kharkov, the prosecutor's office reported. The victim headed a training complex at a Lvov military academy and was on duty with cadets. The suspect is a 23-year-old man with prior convictions. Investigators state he received a contract from an unknown person promising $15,000 for the hit. He arrived in Kharkov, retrieved a Makarov pistol hidden near a shopping centre, and shot the officer. Special services are checking possible involvement of Russian intelligence. @Slavyangrad
